attributes.action: Stop the Bank of England removing historical figures off the bank notes.
attributes.background:
To stop the Bank of England removing all historical figures eg Winston Churchill,  Jane Austen and Alan Turing, from the bank notes and replacing them with animals. 
I think it is very important to keep some if not all of these historical figures on the bank notes, to remind people of the past.

rejection.details:
Banknotes are the responsibility of the Bank of England, which is independent of the Government and Parliament.

You can find out how the Bank decides who/what will be on banknotes here:
https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/banknotes/banknote-characters
